about: All fork work in flight. Nodes carry the handoff: every node not done/parked has a 'next' step a cold session can pick up without chat history. WORK_LEDGER.md is the logbook of finished work.
rules: Never delete a node. Finished -> 'done'; abandoned -> 'parked' with the reason in 'next'.
Every node not 'done' or 'parked' must have a concrete 'next' step that anyone could pick up cold.
'needs' lists ids this node waits on; keep it acyclic.
Update 'status', 'next', and 'updated' in the same commit as the work, and at the end of every working session.
Run python3 .agents/check_tracking.py before committing changes here or to the ledger.

nodes.title: Identify ragesaq's printer model and confirm its wireless channel (BLE vs classic-BT SPP)
nodes.next: Ask ragesaq for the printer model (or read it off the device / vendor app). Then check it against issue #13's framing: newer models are BLE-only (SPP port present but silent — B3S confirmed case). If the model speaks classic SPP, wireless printing may already work via the existing SerialTransport over an OS rfcomm/serial binding — test that first with tools/print-harness before writing any code. Record model, channel findings, and probe output here.

nodes.title: Choose the .NET cross-platform BLE stack (issue #13's 'one real open decision')
nodes.next: Survey candidates named in issue #13: per-OS native (WinRT / CoreBluetooth / BlueZ D-Bus), InTheHand.BluetoothLE, Plugin.BLE. Evaluate: desktop support on Win/macOS/Linux, GPL compatibility, maintenance health, headless friendliness. Study niimblue-node's BLE handling (notify/write + frame reassembly) as the byte-accurate reference. Write the comparison into DECISIONS.json as a proposed decision before coding.

nodes.title: Implement BleTransport behind INiimbotTransport in Niimbot.Net
nodes.next: Branch from upstream/main. New transport: GATT discovery (service e7810a71-73ae-499d-8c15-faa9aef0c3f2 / characteristic bef8d6c9-9c21-4c9e-b632-bd58c1009f9f, fallback discovery rule: long-UUID service with NOTIFY + WRITE_NO_RESPONSE characteristic), subscribe notifications, write-without-response, reassemble 55 55 ... AA AA frames fragmented across notifications (buffer in transport). macOS quirk: connect by device name. Unit-test fragmentation reassembly with a replay transport. Verify on real hardware via print-harness, then full app print path.
